job.title: Work Health Safety Traineeship

The role involves a combination of administrative duties and practical workplace safety activities, with full on-the-job training provided.
Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander candidates are strongly encouraged to apply. This position is open to everyone.

  • Assist with general WHS administration and record keeping
  • Support workplace safety inspections and reporting
  • Assist with safety documentation and compliance processes
  • Gain practical experience in an Industrial environment
  • Work alongside experienced industry professionals

  • A positive attitude and willingness to learn

  • Reliable, motivated and able to work within a team

job.title: Quality & Document Controller
job.description:
Goal Indigenous Services is seeking an experienced Quality & Document Control Officer to join a leading organisation supporting Australia's Defence and Maritime industry in Darwin, NT.

This is a great opportunity for someone with strong document control experience who enjoys working in a structured, compliance-focused environment.
The successful candidate will play an important role in maintaining document management systems, ensuring compliance and supporting quality processes across the business.

Key Responsibilities
  • Maintain and manage document control systems, registers and records.
  • Ensure accurate document tracking, version control and approvals.
  • Support the maintenance of Integrated Management Systems (IMS).
  • Review documentation to ensure compliance with quality standards and procedures.
  • Assist with internal audits, reporting and continuous improvement activities.
  • Prepare and update procedures, work instructions and organisational documentation.
  • Liaise with internal departments to ensure documentation is accurate and up to date.
  • Provide administrative support and guidance on document management processes.
Requirements
  • Minimum 5 years' experience in Document Control, Quality Administration or a similar role.
  • Experience working with Integrated Management Systems (IMS).
  • Good understanding of Quality Management Systems.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 and SharePoint.
  • Strong attention to detail and organisational skills.
  • Experience maintaining compliance records and audit documentation.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work across multiple departments.
  • Experience within Defence, Maritime, Construction or Engineering environments will be highly regarded.
Essential Requirements
  • Must be an Australian Citizen.
  • Must be eligible to obtain and maintain a Baseline Defence Security Clearance.
  • Ability to successfully complete a National Police Check.
Benefits
  • Opportunity to work within Australia's Defence and Maritime sector.
  • Ongoing career development and professional growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team environment.
  • Varied role with exposure to quality, compliance and operational processes.
Apply via link above or email your resume to Cecilia at cewatts@goalis.com.au
